notes.title: New Update : Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/6654d2398145e4f5124a8e78ac4f5acf17337df2.gif[/img]

[h3]1. Game Launches Faster[/h3]

In the past, when you first started the game, all vehicle data would load onto your computer at once. This often caused long wait times. Now, we load each car only when you actually need it.

How does this help? The loading time is reduced when you enter the game. Vehicles appear much faster when you browse the menu or switch to a new map.

[h3]2. Smaller Updates When You Have Internet Connection[/h3]

If there’s an update on Steam, instead of downloading the entire vehicle pack again, we only download the small pieces that have changed.

How does this help? Ongoing updates take up less space and download more quickly. When we add a new car or fix visuals on a model, the update size stays small, so the download time is shorter.

[h3]3. Uses Less Memory (RAM) on Your Computer[/h3]

Because not all cars are loaded into memory at the same time, your computer can run more smoothly while you play.

How does this help? If you play for a long time or change maps, you’re less likely to experience stuttering or lag. This makes the overall experience more fluid and enjoyable.

[h3]4. We Can Add New Cars Instantly[/h3]

When our development team creates new cars, new skins, or extra add-ons, those items become available automatically as soon as you update the game. This means:

You can use new vehicles without needing to download a massive file.

If we only change a few models, only those model files get updated.

[h2][b]Welcome to the Dark Side of Car Trading! 🚨[/b][/h2]

To steal cars, you’ll need lockpicks, which can now be purchased from the black market. Finding the black market might take some effort, but once you gain access, you’re ready for your car theft adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/3a869cb7ca17efa0d610deb94d20f8a2414322f5.png[/img]

Some vehicles will be available for theft during nighttime in neighborhoods. Stealable cars will be marked with a key symbol next to them. However, don’t get too excited when you see this symbol; without a lockpick, you can’t begin the operation. Here’s where your skills come into play:
[list]
[*] The car theft process will be performed through a mini-game.
[*] Use the lockpick to align the green boxes.

[list]
[*] Police inspections of your office will occur on certain days of the week.
[*] If stolen cars are found in your office, getting caught is inevitable.
[*] If caught by the police, you will face fines and severe economic consequences.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/4491f5d4fb4302b6c3eae85b4f0c2623c742fa3a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Penalty System 🚫[/b][/h3]

If caught by the police, your stolen cars will be confiscated, and you’ll suffer significant financial setbacks. So, think carefully about the risks and plan your moves strategically.

[b]However, despite ongoing developments in the background, we wanted to showcase the construction process of our future new office that we shared with you through our Discord server.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/f5c632044f6527d455ca5f990ad0fb9938e72eaf.gif[/img]


[b]We are making significant improvements to the scrapyard system. In a nutshell, we will now have the ability to purchase scrap vehicles. However, our goal is not just to repair and sell these vehicles in a normal way, but to do something different.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/b00fa69515639ebb7cbcdc7d35fbba3965fb5fc7.png[/img]
[u]Note: These updates have not been implemented yet. We wanted to provide information about upcoming updates.[/u]

Here's how it works: In the scrapyard, you inspect and purchase damaged vehicles. However, since these vehicles are heavily damaged, they are currently unusable and require specific parts to function. You have the chance to find these parts in the scrapyard or buy them from someone who sells car parts. Each vehicle will have its own unique parts, so you'll need to find the parts specific to the brand of the vehicle you purchased. Once you have completed the parts, you can start using the vehicle, but it will still require repairs, so it will only move very slowly and be able to go to the repair shop. After taking the car to the repair shop, the mechanic will ask you for specific parts again, and once you provide them, your vehicle will be repaired. Then, if you wish, you can perform painting or cleaning procedures.


Along with this system, an inventory system is also being introduced into the game. You will be able to see the parts you collect or purchase in the inventory.

Thank you.

Hello, friends. We have developed a new save system. Now you don't need to sleep to save the game, and you can save the game anywhere by pressing the ESC key. When you continue your game, you will start from where you left off, not from the bed. Please note that you cannot save the game while in a car. You need to exit the vehicle to save.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused by transitioning to the new save system, as it may result in the deletion of your previous saves. We are sorry for this, but going forward, we will not delete your saves. Thank you for your understanding.

To recover your old save data, 
Press 'Win + R', type 'appdata' into the dialog box, navigate to 'LocalLow -> Red Axe Games -> Car For Sale Simulator 2023 -> Data' and delete 'GameSaves.json'. Then, rename 'GameSave.json' to 'GameSaves.json'.

Please note that while this process may recover your old save data, it will remove cars and retain your money and skills from your previous records.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/55e822c50adb5fd8f3c29282857be216085add3e.png[/img]

[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

First of all, we invite everyone to our Discord channel, where we share screenshots and information about the development of the game. And we can also just chat there!

[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/bwDJjqPQMb


[b][h1]Updates[/h1][/b]
[b][h2]New Cars[/h2][/b]
In the last demo version, 28 cars were available. We understand that this amount will not be enough, so we continue to add new models in the development process. Most of the cars added will be European.

After the game is released in early access, you will be able to offer the car you are interested in to add to the game in our Discord channel! It is quite possible that your favorite car will be added with subsequent updates of early access.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/f81f97c9bac2630f1df90dbc77b2d0b9455bc073.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/8b057dd82514ed485f56009e3a457bead1350cb5.png[/img]

[b][h2]Car Tuning[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/b595659c2563120fa1dbebda8f81fc38ddd8c4c8.jpg[/img]
You can tune your car by contacting a tuning workshop.

We have divided tuning into 3 main areas: regular, drift and racing.

[b]Normal kit:[/b] has standard performance, which is available in the factory version of the car.
[b]Drift kit:[/b] specially selected components for a drift car
[b]Racing Kit:[/b] increases the power of your car, providing high acceleration speed.

In addition, you can install ABS, ESP, TCS systems in your car; install turbocharging and a NoS system.

You can adjust the front and rear suspension of the car and change the color of the headlights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/723acc11eeafa5447cdb0730d27c98d3689b160b.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Gas Station [/h2][/b]
You will need to refuel your cars. You can do it at the gas station. Be careful, if you run out of gas and you stay on the road, you will have to pay for evacuation!
You can see the amount of gasoline in the tank when buying a car, but for this you will need to study the corresponding ability of the skill tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43474063/e59792afb83ec172710560d9c692a3927782efe6.png[/img]

[b][h1]Release Date [/h1][/b]
Yes, let's come to the last question :)
We decided to slightly shift the release date to provide a better and more content-filled product. During the development process, we decided to add new mechanics that we had not previously planned :)
[b] On May 18, 2023 [/b]Car For Sale Simulator 2023 goes into early access.
Thanks
